info.title: AdaptGroup VPN API
info.description:
API for managing VPN subscriptions in your projects.

**Base URL:** `https://network-api.adaptgroup.app`

**Authentication:** pass your API key in the `X-Api-Key` header and integration ID in the request body.

**Rate limit:** 100 requests per 60 seconds per `api_key_id`. Returns `429 Too Many Requests` when exceeded.

[📥 Download OpenAPI spec](/openapi/vpn.json)

post.description:
Renews an existing subscription using the same plan. Extends the end date by the plan's duration and adds traffic if the plan includes a traffic limit.

If the subscription has already expired, the new period starts from now. If it's still active, the new period is added to the current end date.
Freezes an active subscription. The user loses access to VPN servers. The remaining days are preserved — when unfrozen, the end date is extended by the frozen duration.
Unfreezes a frozen subscription. Restores VPN access and extends the end date by the time the subscription was frozen.

Upgrades an active subscription to a more expensive plan. The cost is calculated proportionally based on the remaining days.

**Upgrade price formula:**
```
upgrade_price = (new_price_per_day - old_price_per_day) × remaining_days
```

If both plans include a traffic limit, additional traffic is also added proportionally.

Purchases additional traffic (GB) for a subscription that has a traffic limit (⚡️ servers).

Only available for subscriptions that support traffic limits. The price per GB is set in the dashboard.
Returns the current status and details of a subscription.
Returns a list of devices that have connected to the subscription.
Returns paginated history of connection requests for a subscription.
Removes a device from the subscription. After deletion the device slot is freed and can be used by a new device.
